No adoption or production use is recommended until capacity clears and CTO commissions isolated prototypes.

Revenue boundary: retain Amazon aggregate revenue as unassigned. Available evidence is 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, with site-attributed commission reported as $0. The measurable affiliate experiment is link and click behavior only; no site revenue, ROI, margin, forecast, or causal lift is supportable.

Retain two deferred product opportunities for CEO/CTO review after capacity clears: an execution-ledger integrity layer and AI-usage guardrails. Both begin as read-only or dry-run prototypes using existing records, require no deployment, spend, credentials, domains, or new telemetry, and remain outside the active queue until a delivery slot is released.
